NAAC ACCREDITED GRADE A++
UNIVERSITY CAMPUS, HAZRATBAL, SRINAGAR 190006, KASHMIR.
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the candidates who have submitted their application form
in response to Advertisement Notice No. 04 of 2025, dated 22-05-2025 for the post of
Principal and Assistant Professor (Nursing), Institute of Nursing and Paramedical Sciences
(South Campus) that the provisional status / list of applicants along with the deficiencies, if
any, is given in Annexure I & II to this Notice.
Further, if the candidate finds any discrepancy regarding his/her status, he/she may approach
to the office of the Recruitment Section of the University of Kashmir with documentary proof
within 10 days from the date of issuance of this Notice i.e., up to and including 12-01-2026
No claim after the last date for clearance of deficiencies shall be entertained.
